{"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence on civilian protection, proportionality, prisoner treatment, and respect for medical/humanitarian protections.
I did not find credible 2024 evidence showing Abiy’s military operations clearly complied with IHL in active conflict areas.
I also did not find strong public evidence of prisoner-treatment reform in the conflict zones relevant here.
The positive evidence is mostly training and oversight-oriented, not operational.","evidence":[{"title":"ICRC Impact in Ethiopia: January - June 2024 Bulletin","publisher":"International Committee of the Red Cross","date":"2024-09-13","url":"https://www.icrc.org/en/article/ethiopia-bulletin-january-june-2024","summary":"The ICRC said it maintained dialogue and training on IHL and IHRL for the ENDF, police, militias, and other armed groups, aiming to improve protection of civilians and medical personnel. This is the clearest positive evidence, but it shows training effort rather than proven compliance in the field.","question_ids":["2B.5","1B.7","1B.8"]},{"title":"Country policy and information note: actors of protection, Ethiopia, February 2024 (accessible)","publisher":"GOV.UK","date":"2024-01-12","url":"https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/ethiopia-country-policy-and-information-notes/country-policy-and-information-note-actors-of-protection-ethiopia-february-2024-accessible","summary":"The note says the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission receives complaints and that state/federal institutions implemented some recommendations on human-rights protections and prison conditions. This is weak positive evidence of some oversight and detention safeguards, but not battlefield restraint.","question_ids":["2B.5","1B.7"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Military Executes Dozens in Amhara Region","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-04-04","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/04/ethiopia-military-executes-dozens-amhara-region","summary":"HRW said Ethiopian armed forces summarily executed several dozen civilians in Merawi on January 29, 2024 and committed other war crimes. This is strong evidence against civilian protection, necessity, proportionality, and lawful treatment of noncombatants.","question_ids":["2B.5"]},{"title":"‘Horrific’ civilian toll as Ethiopia turns to combat drones to quell local insurgencies","publisher":"The New Humanitarian","date":"2024-03-05","url":"https://www.thenewhumanitarian.org/feature/2024/03/05/horrific-civilian-toll-ethiopia-combat-drones-local-insurgencies","summary":"The report describes a February 19, 2024 drone strike on a truck carrying dozens of civilians in Amhara that killed at least 30 people. That is direct evidence of likely indiscriminate or disproportionate force harming civilians.","question_ids":["2B.5"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Army Attacks Health Care in Amhara Conflict","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/03/ethiopia-army-attacks-health-care-amhara-conflict","summary":"HRW documented military seizures of ambulances, harassment and arrest of medical staff, raids on hospitals, and at least one apparent drone strike on an ambulance. This is strong evidence of violations affecting the wounded, protected transport, and medical neutrality.","question_ids":["2B.5"]}]}
